name: Yan Ye
source:
Suspended from school due to physical reasons and undergoing rehabilitation in the hospital, claiming to be the Great Demon King who wants to rule all mankind.
Didn't pay much attention to the surroundings until encountering the protagonist.
Have a love for sandwiches.
